Specifying a model

Fitting

One formula, one distribution, and a scheme that fits the terms whose penalties are differentiable all together while the others are alternated around them.

Where a fit begins

A starting value as a strategy rather than a vector of numbers, asked once before the fit alternates. The default is the intercept-only fit; what the others offer is a procedure, from a random perturbation to a global search of the likelihood.

start_search()

Reading a fit

The model as a function of parameters and data, any parameter or moment predicted at new data, what the fit says about its own uncertainty, and the elapsed time in the unit it deserves.

loglik() gradient() hessian()
The Model as a Function of Parameters and Data
format_duration()
Format a Duration in the Unit It Deserves

Installing and updating

The toolkit is not on CRAN, so the install path is GitHub and the dependencies among the members are resolved by pak.

statmodels7_update()
Install or Update the Toolkit
